source.english_context: Unit 04 Home Setup, Utilities, and Maintenance Goal: set up home services and report problems clearly. Daily Life English The heater is not working. There is a leak under the sink. When will the technician come? I need to set up electricity and internet. The power is out in my apartment. There is no hot water. The internet connection keeps dropping. How do I start service at my new address? Can you explain this charge on my bill? The air conditioner is making a loud noise. May I have a repair request number? Will I need to be home for the visit? Where should I put the recycling? When is the next trash pickup? Could you let me know before you arrive? Vocabulary utility a home service like electricity or water bill a request for payment maintenance repair work for a home or building leak water coming out where it should not appointment window a range of time for a visit trash pickup the day trash is collected water heater a device that heats water for a home circuit breaker a safety switch that can turn off an electrical circuit service provider a company that supplies a service recycling bin a container for materials collected to be used again repair request a message asking for something broken to be fixed thermostat a device used to control the temperature in a room US Customs Report repair problems early. Use photos when possible. Some apartments require you to sort trash, recycling, and large items. Utility bills usually arrive every month. Late payment can add fees. Dialogue Student: Hello, I need to report a repair. Manager: What is the problem? Student: There is water under the kitchen sink. Manager: Can a technician come tomorrow morning? Student: Yes. Please send me the time by text.

japanese_explanation.heading: 家の問題は早く、具体的に伝える
points: 水漏れ、暖房、電気、虫、鍵の問題は早めに連絡します。場所、問題、いつ始まったかを短く言えると対応が早くなります。
修理の人が来る時間は、午前9時から午後1時のように幅があることがあります。予定を空けておきましょう。
ゴミ、リサイクル、大型ゴミのルールは地域や建物で違います。近所や管理人に聞くのが普通です。
japanese_explanation.practice: There is a leak under the sink.

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 家里出问题要早说、说具体
points: 漏水、暖气、电、虫子、钥匙问题要尽早联系。能说清地点、问题和开始时间，处理会更快。
维修人员上门常常给一个时间段，比如上午9点到下午1点。那段时间要留在家或安排人开门。
垃圾、回收和大件垃圾规则每个城市或公寓不同。问邻居或管理员很正常。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: There is a leak under the sink.

ko.heading: 집 문제는 빨리, 구체적으로 전달하기
points: 누수, 난방, 전기, 벌레, 열쇠 문제는 조속히 연락해야 합니다. 장소, 문제점, 언제 시작되었는지를 간략하게 전달하면 처리가 빨라집니다.
수리 기사가 방문하는 시간은 오전 9시부터 오후 1시와 같이 시간대가 넓을 수 있습니다. 일정을 비워두세요.
쓰레기, 재활용, 대형 쓰레기 배출 규칙은 지역이나 건물마다 다릅니다. 이웃이나 관리인에게 문의하는 것이 일반적입니다.

points: 漏水、暖气、电、虫子、钥匙问题要尽早联系。能说清地点、问题和开始时间，处理会更快。
维修人员上门常常给一个时间段，比如上午9点到下午1点。那段时间要留在家或安排人开门。
垃圾、回收和大件垃圾规则每个城市或公寓不同。问邻居或管理员很正常。

es.heading: Informe los problemas del hogar pronto y con detalles
points: Informe los problemas de fugas de agua, calefacción, electricidad, insectos y llaves lo antes posible. Si puede indicar brevemente el lugar, el problema y cuándo comenzó, la respuesta será más rápida.
La hora de llegada del técnico de reparaciones puede tener un margen, por ejemplo, de 9 a. m. a 1 p. m. Mantenga su horario libre durante ese tiempo.
Las reglas para la basura, el reciclaje y los artículos grandes varían según la región y el edificio. Es normal preguntar a los vecinos o al administrador.

pt-BR.heading: Relate problemas domésticos cedo e especificamente
points: Problemas de vazamento de água, aquecimento, eletricidade, pragas e chaves devem ser relatados o mais rápido possível. Mencionar brevemente o local, o problema e quando começou pode acelerar a resolução.
O horário de chegada do técnico de reparos pode ser uma janela, como das 9h às 13h. Mantenha sua agenda livre durante esse período.
As regras para lixo, reciclagem e itens volumosos variam conforme a região e o edifício. É comum perguntar aos vizinhos ou ao síndico.

fr.heading: Signalez les problèmes domestiques rapidement et précisément
points: Pour les problèmes de fuite d'eau, de chauffage, d'électricité, d'insectes ou de serrures, contactez rapidement. Une description brève du lieu, du problème et de son début accélérera l'intervention.
L'heure d'arrivée du réparateur peut être une plage horaire, par exemple de 9h à 13h. Veuillez vous assurer d'être disponible pendant cette période.
Les règles concernant les ordures, le recyclage et les articles encombrants varient selon la région et le bâtiment. Il est courant de demander aux voisins ou au gérant de l'immeuble.

de.heading: Melden Sie Hausprobleme frühzeitig und präzise
points: Melden Sie Probleme mit Wasserlecks, Heizung, Strom, Insekten oder Schlüsseln frühzeitig. Wenn Sie den Ort, das Problem und den Beginn kurz beschreiben können, wird die Bearbeitung beschleunigt.
Die Ankunftszeit des Reparaturdienstes kann ein Zeitfenster sein, zum Beispiel von 9 Uhr morgens bis 13 Uhr nachmittags. Halten Sie Ihren Terminkalender in diesem Zeitraum frei.
Die Regeln für Müll, Recycling und große Gegenstände variieren je nach Region und Gebäude. Es ist üblich, Nachbarn oder den Hausverwalter zu fragen.
